'''Noth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[near-Human]] active during the [[New Republic era]].<ref name="THH" />

Noth lived in the wilds of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alvorine]]. When [[Krova (Hutt)|Krova]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] arrived with a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]], he found himself drawn to it and made plans to acquire it for himself.<ref name="THH" />
